Construction Services in Leon, KS

Leon is a small Butler County community of roughly 700 residents southeast of Wichita along US-400, in the rolling terrain north of the Walnut River. It's a rural community — farmsteads, acreage properties, and a small original townsite. Residents choose Leon for the space, the quiet, and the proximity to both Augusta and El Dorado without Wichita's density.

Wheatland Construction is based in El Dorado — Leon is Butler County home territory for us. We permit through Butler County for all rural residential work in the Leon area and through the City of Leon for in-town properties.

What We Build in Leon

Custom Homes

Leon-area rural lots on county routes are popular for custom home construction — acreage properties with privacy and agricultural character. We build custom homes in the Leon area from foundation through finish, handling Butler County permits and all construction with our own crews. See Custom Home Building in Leon →

Home Additions

Older Leon-area farmhouses and rural properties often need more space — room additions, attached garage buildouts, or expanded living areas that make the existing home work better for current use. See Home Additions in Leon →

Basement Finishing

Leon-area rural properties include homes with older basements in various structural conditions. The Butler County clay-loam soil in this part of the county creates seasonal moisture pressure that we assess before any framing begins. We also handle any pre-finishing drainage work needed before the main scope. See Basement Finishing in Leon →

Bathroom Remodeling

Leon-area homes include older properties with original mid-century bathrooms that have seen heavy use for 50 to 70 years. We remodel them completely — new tile, new vanity, updated plumbing where the original systems need it. See Bathroom Remodeling in Leon →

Kitchen Remodeling

Rural Leon-area kitchens often have functional bones but dated finishes — 1970s and 1980s layouts and materials that haven't been updated since they were installed. We handle kitchen remodels from targeted refreshes to full renovations. See Kitchen Remodeling in Leon →

Major Remodels

Older Butler County farmhouses in the Leon area often need comprehensive renovation — projects where structural issues, dated plumbing and electrical, and interior finishes all need addressing at once. We handle major remodel scopes with Butler County permit management. See Major Remodels in Leon →

Roofing

Butler County's hail and wind exposure makes roofing a recurring need in the Leon area. Rural properties are often more wind-exposed than in-town homes. We install roofing systems appropriate for rural Kansas conditions and handle insurance documentation when applicable. See Roofing in Leon →

Leon Permit Jurisdiction

Most Leon-area residential work permits through Butler County. In-town properties may permit through the City of Leon. We determine the correct jurisdiction and handle all permits and inspections.
